512-1719-2691.easyPrerequisites: Ilysian Caryatid and Vizier of Tumbling Sands do not have summoning sickness.
512-1719-2691.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
512-1719-2691.description:
Activate Ilysian Caryatid by tapping it, adding {W}{W}
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Ilysian Caryatid, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.

When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability from step 1.
Repeat.

883-1981-2415-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Ashes of the Abhorrent and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, surveiling 1.
Repeat.

2523-2869-6298.description:
Activate Linvala by sacrificing it.
When Linvala dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Linvala that is a 2/2 legendary Zombie in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Linvala ability.
Repeat using the Linvala token

719-2292-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
719-2292-4302.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

147-7202.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
147-7202.description:
Cast Kindle the Inner Flame by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Kindle the Inner Flame, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Kindle the Inner Flame, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

147-2292-3495.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2292-3495.description:
Cast Breach the Multiverse by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Breach the Multiverse.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Breach the Multiverse, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Breach the Multiverse copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2292-3495.notes: Breach the Multiverse can put all creature cards from all graveyards and libraries onto the battlefield under your control infinitely. It will also infinitely mill all players.

2770-5256-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 2.

339-677-1251-2921.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3693-4613-6843-6861.description:
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself and putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to its replacement effect and Sawhorn Nemesis.
Activate Anti-Venom using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

585-851-4508-5880.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

413-539-2783-5649.description:
Cast Bladewing's Thrall by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Bladewing's Thrall enters, Blasting Station and Nesting Dragon trigger, as Bladewing's Thrall is a land due to Ashaya.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Bladewing's Thrall.
Resolve the Nesting Dragon trigger, creating a 0/2 Dragon Egg creature token.
When the Dragon Egg enters, Blasting Station and Bladewing's Thrall trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Bladewing's Thrall trigger, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3362-6558.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Naga Fleshcrafter
3362-6558.description:
Cast Naga Fleshcrafter by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Bladewing.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Naga Fleshcrafter's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

1786-3591-5636-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
1786-3591-5636-6282.description:
Activate Psychic Frog by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Queza triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Psychic Frog ability.
Repeat.

3634-4067-5922.notablePrerequisites: Helga does not have summoning sickness and has power 4 or greater.
3634-4067-5922.description:
Activate Helga by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}{U} that can only be spent to cast creature spells with mana value 4 or greater or creature spells with {X} in their mana cost.
Cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Helga triggers, causing you to draw a card, gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Helga.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Helga.
Repeat.
3634-4067-5922.notes: If you have enough leftover mana to cast the creature, you can instead substitute untapping another permanent instead of Helga.

343-5478-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
343-5478-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites:
You are the monarch.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
343-5478-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating an untapped Everywhere land token due to Spelunking.
When the Everywhere token enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate Everywhere by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a tapped Everywhere land token.
Repeat from step 3.

964-2793-4064.manaNeeded: {3}{W}{W}{U}{U}{U} available the first turn, with {2}{W}{U}{U} available each extra turn
964-2793-4064.description:
Activate Abuelo by paying {1}{W}{U}, exiling Ugin's Nexus until the beginning of the next end step.
At the beginning of your end step, Abuelo triggers, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to the battlefield.
When Ugin's Nexus enters the battlefield, Replication Specialist triggers, causing you to pay {1}{U} to create a token copy of Ugin's Nexus.
Put the token Ugin's Nexus into exile due to the legend rule and its replacement effect, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Abuelo by paying {1}{W}{U}, exiling Ugin's Nexus until the beginning of the next end step.
Move to your next turn, not skipping it as Ugin's Nexus is not on the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting it from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the creature's trigger, causing you to draw it from the top of your library.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

539-5259-5803.notablePrerequisites:
Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
Kitsa has power 2 or greater and does not have summoning sickness.
539-5259-5803.description:
Cast Rude Awakening by paying {4}{G}, choosing its first mode.
Kitsa's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Kitsa's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Rude Awakening.
Resolve the copy of Rude Awakening, untapping all lands you control.
Repeat from step 3.

955-2933-4499-5798.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

1651-3715-4565-5365.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1651-3715-4565-5365.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting two +1/+1 counters on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

687-2034-3818-5319.notablePrerequisites: Geralf's Messenger does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
687-2034-3818-5319.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger, adding {C}{C}.
When Geralf's Messenger dies, its undying ability and Sengir's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Geralf's Messenger trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter and a vigilance counter on it.
When Geralf's Messenger enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Sengir trigger, putting two +1/+1 counters on Sengir.
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing a +1/+1 counter from Sengir, and both counters from Geralf's Messenger.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat steps 2-5 one additional time.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Geralf's Messenger, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability from step 6, causing you to mill three cards and returning Geralf's Messenger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Geralf's Messenger enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing an opponent to lose 2 life.
Repeat.

575-2345-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken land creature.
575-2345-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a nontoken land creature.
When the land creature dies, Yedora triggers, returning the card to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
When the Forest enters the battlefield, Embodiment of Insight triggers, causing the Forest to become a 3/3 Elemental creature with haste in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 1, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate the Elemental by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

1218-1819-2135.notablePrerequisites: You have at least ten creature cards in your graveyard.
1218-1819-2135.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Syr Konrad +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Activate Elixir of Immortality by paying {2} and tapping it, causing you to gain 5 life and shuffle Elixir of Immortality and your graveyard into your library.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card that left your graveyard this way, giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

57-2178-4813-5231.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent has lost life this turn.
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon.
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
57-2178-4813-5231.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Famished Foragers that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When Famished Foragers enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Famished Foragers, adding {R}.
When Famished Foragers dies, Feldon triggers, untapping Feldon.
Repeat.
